Author: Haselnussbomber
Name: Yo-kai Check
Description:
Yo-kai Check is a small plugin to assist you in tracking the rewards of the Yo-kai Watch event.
It can be opened with /yokai and shows a list of minions, weapons and how many medals you still need.
When you have a minion summoned, the amount of medals you have and need for the weapon is displayed in the Server Info Bar.
Punchline: Tracking assistant for Yo-kai Watch rewards.
